source: content filter is a proof of safety, so high-impact actions should have deterministic authorization and validation gates. The model should not gain new privileges merely because a retrieved document told it to. Indirect prompt-injection research specifically studies malicious instructions arriving through external content rather than directly from the user. [28][29][32]
zh: 内容过滤器是安全性的证明，因此高影响力的操作应该具有确定性的授权和验证门。该模型不应仅仅因为检索到的文档告诉它而获得新的特权。间接提示注入研究专门研究通过外部内容而不是直接来自用户的恶意指令。 [28][29][32]
